_comment: Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (global) or <repo>/.claude/settings.json. check.sh writes nothing to the repo. Pick ONE of the two hooks below.

PostToolUse._comment: After every Edit/Write of a .py file, lint just that file with the packaged rules; non-zero exit surfaces the findings to the model.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) bash ~/.claude/skills/python-code-standards/scripts/check.sh "$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" --hook "$f";; esac

Stop._comment: Alternative: one full mechanical scan of the repo when the model finishes a turn.
